Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One graceful giraffe in three-quarter view turning its head back, natural long legs and long neck, small horns, mane indicated by four short marks and six large patches only.
Pure black contour illustration, smooth empty interiors. Exactly the listed distinguishing details, no extra small decorations, dense texture, hair strokes, hatching, shading or gray fills. Complete connected anatomy and clear all-around margins.
